competing_explanation: The 30-day figure may reflect an outdated policy, a promotional offer, or a category-specific exception rather than the current standard-item policy.
hypothesis_statement: The current policy for standard items provides a full-refund return window of 30 days from the date of delivery.
refutation_criterion: Current authoritative policy text states a different return period, a non-full-refund condition, or that the 30-day window does not apply to standard items.
